title: SeaBass Fishing 2
native_title: シーバス・フィッシング ２
overview:
Realistic visuals and powerful fight scenes in 3D graphics, plus outstanding controls. This is the ultimate lure fishing game!

The second installment of the full-fledged sea fishing simulation game targeting the sea bass (suzuki in Japanese), popular for its fierce fights.

Cast from rocky shores and other fishing spots, then battle your catch while watching line length, depth and tension. During a fight you can switch freely between the above-water view and an underwater view of the fish. Working the rod and moving your footing add to the feel of real fishing.

- 18 kinds of fish, including sea bass, yellowtail and flounder
- Popular Daiwa lures and tackle appear under their real names
- A fishing guidance corner with live-action movies by sea bass lure fishing expert Masami Murakoshi

3Dグラフィックによるリアルな映像と迫力のファイトシーン、そして卓越した操作性。これが究極のルアーフィッシングゲーム!

強烈なファイトで人気の高いシーバス（日本名スズキ）をターゲットにした本格的海釣りシミュレーションゲーム第2弾。
